title: Cache policies and add audit logging to the request guard
pr_body: Policy files are read on every request. Cache them, log authorization decisions for the audit trail and stop treating projects without a policy file as errors.

files.after:
"""Loads the per-project access policy."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

POLICY_DIR = Path("/etc/app/policies")
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Policy:
    project: str
    denied: frozenset[tuple[str, str]]

    def denies(self, role: str, action: str) -> bool:
        return (role, action) in self.denied or ("*", action) in self.denied


@lru_cache(maxsize=256)
def load_policy(project: str) -> Policy | None:
    """Return the project's policy, or None when the project has no policy file yet."""
    path = POLICY_DIR / f"{project}.json"
    if not path.exists():
        log.info("no policy file for project %s", project)
        return None
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return Policy(project, frozenset((d["role"], d["action"]) for d in data["deny"]))

"""Request guard: checks the caller's role against the project policy."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from app.errors import Forbidden
from app.policy import load_policy

audit = logging.getLogger("audit")


def authorize(user, project: str, action: str) -> None:
    policy = load_policy(project)
    if policy and policy.denies(user.role, action):
        audit.warning("denied %s %s on %s", user.id, action, project)
        raise Forbidden(f"{user.role} may not {action} in {project}")
    audit.info("allowed %s %s on %s", user.id, action, project)

bugs.title: Authorization fails open when a project has no policy
bugs.rationale: load_policy now returns None instead of raising, and authorize only denies when a policy exists. Any project id without a policy file (including mistyped or attacker-chosen ids) now allows every action for every role.

acceptable.rationale: Policies are cached forever; edits to policy files need a restart.
